stalls: From the one public photo (inside a straight covered alley): continuous 1-2 floor shop fronts on both sides, ~3-4 m bays, open fronts or grey roll shutters, goods on low tables/crates pushed ~0.8-1.2 m into the alley leaving ~2-2.5 m walkway. No fabric awnings or parasols under the roof; instead flat fascia signboards above each front (mixed white, yellow, red, green panels) plus projecting round white signs with red lettering and red paper lanterns hung at ~3 m. Strings of small international flags (bunting) criss-cross the alley under the arch; LED lights on the ceiling (2017 night-lighting project). Floor light grey concrete/tile with a darker centre drainage strip. Gate colours were not seen in any source: [70,85,110] steel-blue frame with a white sign board is a default guess.
seen: Satellite z19: north of the 9 m E-W road (y 1609-1648) a comb-shaped run of uniform white roofs exactly alley-wide: E-W strip x 1125-1263 at y 1507-1525 (4.3 m, two brightness halves split at y~1516 = curved/two-slope roof) and two N-S arms at x 1161-1175 and 1211-1225 from y 1525 down to the road edge at 1608; north of the E-W strip is a cleared lot (the area has been in redevelopment for 15+ years). These match a translucent barrel-vault 비가림 arcade. The OSM outline south of the road is a grey flat-roofed hall with skylights. News (2017): market grew out of a '강남상가' building, ~110 shops, alleys split N/S/E/W with a large crossing used for events, ceiling LED lights; later news: merchants asked for repair of the 비가림막 (rain cover) and lighting. Newdaily 2016 overall photo (looked at in browser, not saved): long straight alley under a low pale translucent arched roof on dark ribs, flags and lanterns hung beneath, shops both sides. Street view: no panorama within ~50 m (nearest at px y~1352 and SE alley at 1349,1835 show only residential lanes), so gates/colours unverified. Which satellite alley the photo shows is not certain; the exact link between the north arcade and the OSM hall is inferred.
